phase_prompt.label: The Hesitant Architect
phase_prompt.summary: Samsapeel gathering the chiefs at the summit, burdened by the foresight of the fatal error. He is the reluctant leader of the breach.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Close-up portrait of Samsapeel, the Architect, in a moment of heavy silence. His obsidian face is etched with sorrow, the violet circuitry under his skin pulsing slowly. He holds a jagged memory-crystal tablet close to his chest. The background is a blurred, dark mountain summit with the faint grid-lines of the sky-dome visible above. The lighting is cool moonlight, creating a sharp rim light on his data-glass armor. Cinematic depth of field, 85mm lens, hyper-realistic texture details.
